purpose: Official references for dataset preparation and independently implemented project experiments. The mirrored notebook is an attributed tutorial reference, not an experimental result.

notes: The v6 row key is the pair numerai_ticker and date. The time grouping column is date, replacing era.
The target alias refers to target_jupiter_60. Targets depend on future returns, and immature target values must be excluded for the exact selected target.
List current API files rather than assuming old dataset versions remain downloadable.
A target alias does not override the scoring configuration of a live round.
v6 was released for modeling on 2026-10-16. Live submissions and model uploads switch on 2026-11-06.
The Unity live payout scores are NCORR and NMMC. Raw Numerai CORR can be an additional research metric but does not reproduce NCORR.
v6 shares its base data and neutralizers with Signals v3.1.

validation.embargo_rule: date > max(mature training date before sampling) + pandas.offsets.BDay(60)

notes: Compute the embargo cutoff using the original mature training rows, before any computational sampling.
The official sample is a memory-conscious teaching baseline, not a tuned tournament solution.
Prediction and neutralizer rows must align exactly. Reject missing or duplicate merge keys and missing neutralizer values.
A fixed public benchmark contribution backtest is only a directional offline proxy. It is not the live historical NMMC or NBMC score.
Export diagnostics with numerai_ticker, date, and within-date percentile-ranked prediction.
neutral_correlation centers targets; predictions are ranked with average ties, Gaussian transformed, and neutralized; the residuals are scored with Pearson correlation.
neutral_correlation does not apply the 1.5 power transform used by raw Numerai CORR and does not normalize residual variance.
neutralize adds an intercept column and uses numpy.linalg.lstsq with rcond=1e-6. Input indices must match exactly and neither matrix may contain NaN.

neutral_contribution neutralizes both Gaussian-ranked predictions and benchmark, orthogonalizes predictions to benchmark, and dots them with centered targets divided by row count. Targets wholly within [0,1] are multiplied by four before centering.
The scoring helpers sort aligned indices internally. Use a unique stable row index for each scored date and merge by explicit keys; pandas positional alignment alone is insufficient.
Use numeric floating neutralizer matrices, verify finite values, and preserve every neutralizer column. One least-squares solve may score multiple prediction columns at once.
Raw Numerai CORR averages ties, Gaussian-transforms ranked predictions, centers targets, applies signed power 1.5 to both, and computes Pearson correlation.
Log it as a secondary metric when the primary v6 experiment objective is NCORR.
v6 model uploads open with the round starting 2026-11-06. Select v6.0 explicitly and do not upload a v6 pickle using a v5 data version.
A local validation experiment does not constitute a live submission.
NumerAPI.list_datasets returns currently available filenames.
NumerAPI.download_dataset accepts pandas Parquet filters. A filtered download reads only matching remote row groups and writes a local Parquet subset; its coverage must be recorded as a subset.
For column projection and memory limits, read a signed Parquet URL with fsspec/pyarrow or pandas and explicitly select columns.

observed_validation_schema.key_dtype: numerai_ticker and date are physical strings
observed_validation_schema.pandas_index: No physical index column; explicit stock/date keys required
observed_validation_schema.small_medium_numeric_feature_dtype: int8 for every numeric feature in the union

schema_caveat: Physical schema and partition counts above were inspected from the completed local validation file. Train and neutralizer physical schemas remain to be verified from their completed downloads.
